short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.
progress_note: G8.3 Banks and Floodplain Shaping is ACCEPTED after exact-Windows full acceptance on tested head ce8b76f5ba46c3ed105ab6d4ee71ab7d8aadaf50 with G8.2 parent PASS, banks/floodplain PASS, valley+river+banks/floodplain composition PASS, ownership PASS, world/core regression through NX4 PASS, RL3 representation-aware streaming 175 assertions, RL3 process streaming 37 assertions, main_scene_cli_all 6 PASS / 0 FAIL, STOPPED lifecycle and CLEAN working tree. G8.4 is now implemented as a static signed erosion/deposition redistribution baseline over exact G8.3 output. It uses the same accepted surface-height, valley-influence, river-distance and river-width semantics. Channel interior remains zero; an erosion lobe spans normalized distance 1.0 -> peak 1.35 -> 2.0; a deposition lobe spans 2.0 -> peak 3.25 -> 5.5. The signed component is erosion_deposition_max_delta_m * (deposition_weight - erosion_weight) * valley_influence. G8.4 preserves exact valley, river, bank and floodplain components and writes only erosion_deposition_delta_m. It does not claim sediment mass conservation, time integration, Matter mutation, fluid water-level semantics, material, persistence, authority or network ownership. Focused and full Windows validation are pending.
